items.title: Willie Hightower Interview, 1958-06-03
items.q: I went to my boss one day and told him, Mr. Brown, and told him that I thought that I was going to play music.

ctx.x: Okay, it's going if you want to give your name and how you were born and playing.

You ready? Yes, it's all right. Well, my name is Willie H. Hightower. I was born in Nashville, Tennessee on President Polk's Hill in 1889, October the 23rd, 7.30 in the morning. My mother and father left Nashville, Tennessee when I was six years old and went to New Orleans, Louisiana, which my uncle was living there, my mother's brother. And from time to time, where I grew and I worked for the New Orleans Ice Cream Company, my oldest place that I stayed as long as I did. From the date that I started to work was…
That was the Brown Ice Cream Company.
